primary_work.title: Generative Intervention Models for Causal Perturbation Modeling
primary_work.official_code: not located from primary records and targeted GitHub search

decision: NARROWED TO ANCHORED JOINT IDENTIFICATION BEYOND FEATURE-CONDITIONED GENERATIVE INTERVENTION MODELS — NOT ADOPTED
rejected_claims: feature-conditioned unknown-target intervention prediction is itself a new raw-language contribution
unseen perturbation outcome prediction identifies the latent intervention-target partition
interpretable target probabilities establish population identifiability
remaining_rq: After accounting for feature-conditioned generative intervention models, can a preregistered population language channel with externally fixed denotational constraints jointly identify raw-utterance equivalence classes and a residual latent intervention-target partition, rather than merely learning a predictive utterance-to-intervention distribution jointly recodable with the causal model?
